title: KAITO — It's About The Particulars, No?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Heya! MEIKO, everyone, are you all here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It feels like it's been so long since all four of you last visited together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can't stay long since our event's fast approaching on top of us getting two new songs ready for it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, two new songs?
I thought you guys were just doing the one that you and An wrote, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We didn't plan for two originally.
Toya ended up making his own track.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And it was so awesome that we felt like we had to sing it during our next event!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cool! Way to go, Toya!
Does this mean what we discussed with Kohane that time...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, shush!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What was that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Uhh... What I meant was... I thought it was just you and An doing the songwriting, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, we just went over that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Mind if I asked you all to listen to it...?
I put quite a lot of thought into this song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I'm being a little selfish by wanting to make my own track. I get that I should be focusing on putting on a good performance right now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's wrong with doing what you want to do? If I were in your position, Azusawa, I would've made the same decision.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I see. Toya was in the same position as her.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna hear it!
Show us what you made, Toya!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to hear it as well!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Toya... You made this...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool! I didn't know you could make anything like this! It's like my heart's ready to jump out of my chest right now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, it's quite incredible...
I can tell that you took a long, hard look at your music in order to make this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
This wouldn't have been possible without all of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I'm so glad that I can finally tell you all about it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Since this is Toya we're talking about, I have a feeling that something was going on... But it must've been so hard for him to keep this a secret.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Still, it's a very good track.
I agree with Rin. I'm also getting this strange feeling in my chest.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and I have a feeling that it has the power to get any crowd going.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You come across these sorts of songs from time to time when you're a DJ.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Songs where the way the crowd reacts makes it feel like they were meant to be played by me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I get to listen to it from the closest position. I essentially have the best seat in the house.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And this is just one of those songs, you know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You'll be the ones performing this on stage. That means you're also going to be in the best seats.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that your track is going to propel everybody forward, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Forward...
That would make me very happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually, I believe it's already having that effect.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, you're all probably having trouble containing yourselves after listening to his track, no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well... Of course...
It's way different from the tracks I usually make, and it made me want to work on it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I felt the same way.
I'm coming up with the lyrics for Toya's song and keep thinking that I can do better!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I want to gain more experience as a performer and sing in a way that shows everyone how much thought you all put into your songs!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And I need to do what I can to help make Kohane's track the best it can be!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, Kohane, let's do our best...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Rin, just Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: H-Haha! Don't worry about that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The way they all push each other forward... They really are an incredible team.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, indeed♪
As long as they keep doing that, they should naturally get better and better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, I'm all for them taking on these sorts of new challenges.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... New challenges, huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Do you also want to try something new, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, not me. You, KAITO.
You should try doing something new.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me? Such as...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um... Like... Cleaning the cafe!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Opening and closing each day might be good too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe...! Yeah, it might do you some good.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... Cleaning the cafe, as well as opening and closing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Taking on new challenges is certainly important, but so is dividing up the work.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For example, I contribute to this cafe by drinking coffee every day and checking to make sure it tastes okay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, to be fair, it always tastes delicious!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ugh! KAITO, you never take anything seriously!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha!
